priya (ml): Quick sync 1: new model bring-up for qbridge-4b-int4. Before canary we need: prompt pruning rules, a micro-golden set, and a quant-compat eval. Naive dedupe found ~3.2% overlap.

anika (eng-ml): Can you share overlap shape? long-tail or concentrated? :eyes:

priya (ml): Mostly long-tail paraphrases + repeated boilerplate (API examples, docs). Ran embedding dedupe (cosine 0.88) then text-hash.

jon (curation): For pruning: avoid auto-removing edge-case prompts. Proposal: auto-prune only when cluster_size > 5 AND label_variance < 0.02. Otherwise flag for human review.

devon (label ops): Labeling bandwidth: we can do ~800 manual reviews this week if batched (200/day). Do we want light sanitize or full golden relabel?

sam (prod-mle): Proposed canary gates: token-level logprob delta, rerank AUC delta, hallucination rate. Gate thresholds: top-1 accuracy drop <= 0.8%, hallucination delta <0.5pp, mean latency increase <5ms.

priya (ml): Plan: offline sim on 2k curated prompts (mix: golden + high-variance + tail), then 5% microcanary with traffic routing and fallback to fp16 if needed.

jon (curation): Micro-golden composition draft: 600 verified golden, 700 edgecases flagged for relabel, 700 random tail. Exclude PII flagged prompts. ETA 48h.

devon (label ops): We'll prioritize the 700 edgecases. Please export CSV with columns: id, prompt, prev_labels, cluster_id, provenance. We'll append labeler_notes.

priya (ml): Export OK. Quick dedupe snippet I used: ```sql
-- embedding dedupe: cluster by nearest neighbor cosine >= 0.88
WITH emb AS (SELECT id, embed FROM prompts)
SELECT id, cluster_id FROM clusterize(emb, 0.88);
-- then text-hash: keep 1 per sha256(prompt) unless cluster_size > 5 AND var(label) > 0.02
```

anika (eng-ml): Eval harness must mirror serving: tokenizer v2, same byte-level settings. Run both int4 and fp16, export outputs + logprobs.

sam (prod-mle): Add rerank pass using production ranker; capture delta distribution and tails not only means.

rollout-bot: Canary checklist created: tasks assigned curation:jon, labeling:devon, eval:sam/priya. Offline sim cron set for 03:00 UTC.

jon (curation): Q: auto-accept prune for short-form clusters (<20 tokens)? I propose yes when cluster_size > 10, keep 2 reps.

priya (ml): Agree: short-form clusters >10 auto-prune to 2 reps, tag others pruned-auto with provenance. Longer prompts stay manual.

devon (label ops): Noted. We'll relabel the 700 edgecases; auto-pruned ones archived and rehydratable if regression shows up.

anika (eng-ml): Timeline: jon 48h microset, devon 5 business days for labels, offline sim tomorrow, microcanary ~72h after labels + pass gates. OK?

priya (ml): Yep. I'll post eval scripts & results here after sim.

sam (prod-mle): Final gate: if top-1 golden drop >0.5% abort and file regression ticket. Otherwise gradual ramp.

priya (ml): Follow-ups assigned: jon -> micro-golden CSV (48h), devon -> labeler queue & relabel plan, anika -> tokenizer parity check in harness, sam -> rerank tail metric. I'll run offline sim and share logs. :+1:

rollout-bot: Offline sim started (job_id: offline-sim-6123456789). Will post results when done.
